name: guard-sweep-reports-even-when-it-skips
find:
- name: Say whether the scheduled sweep is still running
        if: always() && matrix.shard == 1
replace:
- name: Say whether the scheduled sweep is still running
        if: always() && steps.due.outputs.due == 'true' && matrix.shard == 1
breaks: the only step that would report a gate stuck shut runs only when the gate is open, so a sweep that proves nothing for a month reports a healthy schedule throughout (#989, L106)
